outcome: neonatal outcomes (Apgar scores, birth weight, sepsis rates, need for ventilation, duration of hospital stay, neonatal jaundice)
cohort: 87 pregnant women presenting with premature rupture of membranes at gestation between 28 and 36 completed weeks
finding: There were no significant differences in neonatal and maternal outcomes between HIV-positive and HIV-negative women with PPROM on ART, except for a higher risk of neonatal jaundice in the HIV-positive group.
